The Åland University of Applied Sciences Library is located within the Mariehamn City Library and provides service to both students and faculty of the Åland University of Applied Sciences.
The Åland University of Applied Sciences Library is located within the Mariehamn City Library (Strandgatan 29) and provides services to both students and faculty of the university. You can borrow course literature, look for online material in academic databases or make an appointment with a librarian for help with information retrieval. The library is a great place to study; we have study rooms, computers, chromebooks and wireless network. Visit us to get your free library card.
